title: AI-guided prediction of liposomal multi-antioxidant formulations mimicking the human antioxidant network

contributions.purpose: 用 AI 预测五组分抗氧化网络共包封脂质体的包封率
contributions.mechanism: 基于文献+实验数据训练 Random Forest / XGBoost / 神经网络,输入脂质组成、药物亲疏水性、制备条件,输出总 EE%
contributions.evaluation: 交叉验证 RMSE/R²(未给具体数值);CPU(i7-6700K)单模型训练 2-15 分钟
contributions.domain: AI 辅助药物递送/脂质体制剂
contributions.source_quote: We constructed AI models, including Random Forest, XGBoost, and Neural Networks, based on multi-omics and experimental data.

contributions.purpose: 识别决定共包封效率的关键特征
contributions.evaluation: 药物/总脂质比与总脂质浓度影响最大,胆固醇比例次之(定性,无量化排序数字)
contributions.source_quote: the ratio of drug to total lipid and total lipid concentration were found to have the greatest influence on encapsulation efficiency.

contributions.purpose: 实验验证 AI 推荐配方并建立迭代闭环
contributions.mechanism: 按 AI 推荐条件制备脂质体,TEM/DLS/ζ 电位表征,测 EE% 反馈回模型
contributions.source_quote: we established an iterative loop where AI proposed liposome formulations, which were then experimentally validated, and feedback from experimental results continuously improved the predictive accuracy of the AI model.

self_declared_provenance.quote: This method can be considered an improvement over the traditional thin-film hydration method, with the advantage of minimizing or excluding the use of organic solvents.

notes: 数据红旗:所谓‘predicted vs actual 高相关’存疑——AI‘预测值’以极宽区间给出(VitC 26.46-54.40、ALA 54.00-95.58、Q10 77.58-96.00),实测点落在宽区间内是平凡满足,验证近乎无意义;训练集大小未披露(自认‘somewhat limited’),仅单批次。是否真做湿实验难核实:匿名投稿、无原始数据(‘proprietary… upon request’),制备段全是带范围的通用配方(50-60°C、10-12 kDa 等),读起来像 AI 生成的 SOP 而非实测结果;Figure 1/2 的 TEM 图描述泛化。trade-off:数据集小限制泛化;checklist 用 Liner AI,写作自评 [D](AI 主导)。reject。
